author: DOC-029 source-review author agent (documents)
scope: Source review only. No walkthrough was run. Catalog status was not changed. An independent agent must walk the corrected bytes.
commonSources: CONTEXT.md (Document, Document Version, Executed pin, Business User, Member+, Portal)

docs/decision-records/DECISIONS-DOCUMENTS.md (DOC-001 Matter Kind addendum, DOC-006 drag and folder disclosure addenda, DOC-010/DOC-011 upload results and bulk actions addendum, repository filter paragraph)

corrections.before: Business Users can supply supporting Documents but cannot append to a Contract's primary Document.
corrections.after: Business Users on a Contract or Matter team upload Documents and add Versions in the Portal, including a new Version of the primary Contract Document. They cannot change designations, kinds, or folders, or archive or delete paper.
corrections.evidence: routes.ts removed the Contributor primary-chain 403 and documents Business User appends to any accessible Document; documents-section.tsx offers Add version on every row; DD-024.

corrections.before: Upload and Add version always ask for Kind; a Legal user can correct Kind on any hand-set Version.
corrections.after: A Matter upload has no Kind control, Add version asks for Kind only where the record shows it, and Matter Documents have no Kind correction control.
corrections.evidence: documents-card.tsx hides the Kind column and composer Kind for entityType matter; routes.ts forces general for Matter uploads; DOC-001 Matter Kind addendum.

corrections.before: Heading 'File a Contract conversation attachment'; the action is File; Matter comments do not offer filing.
corrections.after: Heading 'File a Contract or Matter conversation attachment'; the action is File to Contract or File to Matter, also offered from the attachment preview; Kind is a Contract-only field; the Confidential switch label is the same on a Matter and restricts to the Matter team.
corrections.evidence: comment-attachments.tsx labels comments.attachments.fileContract / fileMatter and hides Kind on Matter; matter-record.tsx sets canFile for Member+ on an unfrozen Matter; comments/routes.ts files to Matter with a Matter team check. No other guide or help context links the old heading anchor.

corrections.before: Business Users should ask Legal to update a primary Document.
corrections.after: Business Users should ask Legal to change a designation.
corrections.evidence: DD-024 lets Business Users append primary Versions; designations stay Legal.

confirmed: Upload, Choose files, Choose file, Note, Upload, Add version, Edit details, Save labels.
Several chosen files open the batch import dialog.
Kind options Draft · ours, Draft · theirs, Redline · theirs, Redline · ours, Amendment, Executed; Generated redline is not hand-settable and cannot be corrected.
Primary, Make primary, Mark as executed copy, Unmark as executed copy on Contracts only; Set as primary on Knowledge.
An archived owning record refuses new paper.
File attachment dialog: Destination, New Document, New Version on an existing Document, Document name, Document, Note, File; Legal Only attachment preselects Confidential.
Business Users get no filing action (canFile is Member+).

corrections.before: After Save, expand the folder to read its Documents.
corrections.after: Only a folder with Documents or subfolders shows an expand control; an empty folder has none.
corrections.evidence: FolderRows draws the chevron only when documentCount > 0 or child folders exist; DOC-006/DES-033 folder disclosure addendum.

corrections.before: Folder action New folder inside; the owning record itself is the move-out destination.
corrections.after: Folder action New subfolder; None is the top-level choice in Move into and File in; Documents can also be dragged onto a folder row or onto Drop here to move out of folders, or moved in bulk with checkboxes and Move.
corrections.evidence: en-US documents.folder.action.newInside = New subfolder, documents.folder.recordRoot = None, documents.drag.root, documents.bulk.move; DOC-006 drag addendum.

corrections.before: Select Version kind for every import.
corrections.after: A Matter import has no Version kind control.
corrections.evidence: batch-dialog.tsx hides batch-kind when entityType is matter.

corrections.before: Read the final counts, then select Done.
corrections.after: A fully successful import closes after the list refreshes; a failure keeps the dialog open with counts and Done.
corrections.evidence: batch-dialog.tsx calls onClose when every row succeeded, folders succeeded and nothing was unreadable; DOC-010/DOC-011 addendum.

corrections.before: Business Users upload supporting paper at the record root.
corrections.after: Business Users upload several files at the record root in the Portal.
corrections.evidence: Staff record routes are Member+ (canReadContracts); portal documents-section.tsx uploads with no folder; routes.ts refuses a Business User destination.

confirmed: New folder, Name, Save, Actions for the … folder, Rename, Move, Move into, Move to folder, File in, Delete labels.
Folder name and cycle refusals are unchanged in folders.ts.
Folder Delete dissolves into the parent or the record: 'Anything in it moves into … Nothing is deleted.'
Import dialog: Destination, Record root, Version kind, 'Applied to every file in this import. Notes are not collected in bulk.', Import # files, Cancel remaining, Retry, Retry # files, Done.
Choose folder in the Upload dialog; retry is offered only where a retry could succeed.
Knowledge Items have no Document folders.

corrections.before: The Portal does not grant a Contract's full Version history.
corrections.after: Business Users read earlier Versions of permitted Contract and Matter paper in the Portal.
corrections.evidence: portal/documents.ts returns every Version; documents-section.tsx lists earlier versions with read and download; DD-024.

corrections.before: In the Portal, select a Request or comment attachment to download it.
corrections.after: Contract and Matter Documents open in the Portal reader from the Documents section, with earlier Versions and download buttons; Request Attachments download; comment attachment names open a preview with Download, or 'Preview unavailable. You can download the original file.'
corrections.evidence: record-shell.tsx mounts DocPanel for Portal records; portal-request.tsx AttachmentList uses download links; attachment-preview.tsx fetches preview=true and shows PDF or image, else the unavailable message.

confirmed: Reader labels: Previous page, Next page, Zoom out, Zoom in, Find in document, Download, Close the document, v{number}.
Preparing this document for reading… and This file could not be prepared for reading here. Download it to read it.
Download-only staff rows use a download link; the reader shows 'This file type does not open here. Download it to read it.'
Email reader headers and attachment list are unchanged apart from the reader source context.
Portal Knowledge still lists Download buttons with the primary Document first and no in-app preview.
Staff Document routes stay Member+ for the repository; Business User version reads are limited to live Contract and Matter Documents.

corrections.before: Visible filters above the list; Owner choices Contracts, Matters, Entities, Knowledge; Record typed and matched.
corrections.after: Filters open from the Filter button; Owner adds Auto-Docs; choices use Search choices and Apply.
corrections.evidence: document-filter-bar.tsx builds RecordFilterBar definitions including auto_doc; record-filter-bar.tsx labels Filter, Search choices, Apply.

corrections.before: Uploaded from and Uploaded to filters; one value per filter.
corrections.after: One Uploaded filter with From and To, inclusive; Format, Kind, Counterparty and Uploader accept several values that match any selected value, and different filters must all match.
corrections.evidence: en-US removed documents.filter.uploadedFrom/uploadedTo and added documents.filter.uploaded; recordFilters.matchAny and recordFilters.inclusive; repository.ts uses inArray and an exclusive next-day upper bound.
Show archived is a flag filter in DocumentFilterBar for Member+.

corrections.before: Member+ find Contract, Matter, Entity, and Knowledge Documents; folder management is only on the record.
corrections.after: Auto-Doc Documents are included; a live Contract, Matter, or Entity row can be dragged onto a Move to folder target inside its owning record; Auto-Doc Documents have no folders.
corrections.evidence: repository.ts and document-access.ts add the auto_doc owner; documents.tsx rowDrag and DocumentDropFolders; DOC-006 drag addendum.

confirmed: Recent shows five Documents ordered by current Version upload time and hides while any filter is active.
Record, Folder, Record root, Counterparty, Uploader labels; Clear all and Remove … filter.
Row activation opens the owning record with the current Version selected (documentLandingPath).
Restore action column for archived rows; the repository is Member+ only.

corrections.before: Type the Document's displayed name in 'Type … to confirm'.
corrections.after: Type delete in 'Type "delete" to confirm'; the dialog names the Document and its Version count; a rename during the dialog makes the API refuse.
corrections.evidence: DeleteDialog matches typed text to 'delete' and sends document.title; routes.ts still compares confirmTitle to the title; DOC-010/DOC-011 addendum.

corrections.before: Archive, restore, and delete act on one Document at a time.
corrections.after: The selection bar offers Archive for live selections, Restore for archived selections, and Administrator Delete with the same typed word.

corrections.before: Turn on Show archived in the Documents repository.
corrections.after: In the repository, select Filter, then Show archived.
Business Users add Documents and Versions in the Portal.

confirmed: Archive and Restore are row Actions items for Member+; Delete is Administrator only (canErase).
Show archived switch on the owning record is hidden on an archived record.
Erasure removes Versions, renditions, comparison files and extracted text and logs document.hard_deleted.
An Auto-Doc template Document is refused with 409; this is outside the article's owning-record scope.
Individual Versions cannot be deleted.

limitations: Source inspection only; no browser walkthrough, screenshot or API call was made.
The evidence records under docs/documentation/evidence/ still name the previous content hashes and app build; they were not restamped.
